chars.GIRL: a 22-year-old Moroccan young woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie, light-blue jeans and small silver hoop earrings
chars.KOREAN: a young Korean man in his twenties with bleached blond hair, wearing a black leather jacket over a white t-shirt, black jeans and a thin silver chain
chars.DAD: a Moroccan father in his fifties with a short grey beard, wearing a beige djellaba and a white taqiya cap
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her late forties wearing a dark green kaftan and a light grey headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from her bedroom doorway: GIRL sits on her bed in a Moroccan bedroom holding her phone up in a video call, eyes wide with surprise; on the phone screen KOREAN waves excitedly. Head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible. No text anywhere.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: GIRL laughs on her bed, hand over mouth, shaking her head as if she thinks it's a joke, phone in her other hand. Warm evening light, Moroccan bedroom with patterned blanket. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: GIRL freezes, staring at her phone in shock, jaw dropped, sitting up straight on her bed; the phone screen glows on her face (screen not readable). No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: KOREAN with two Korean friends pulling suitcases out of the arrivals hall of Casablanca Mohammed V airport, KOREAN smiling and pointing ahead excitedly, palm trees outside. Main subjects in the center. No readable signs, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sits on the edge of her bed, hand pressed on her chest, panicked expression, phone face-down beside her, worried thinking. Moroccan bedroom at night, lamp light. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a hallway: GIRL peeks nervously around the doorway at DAD and MOM sitting on a traditional Moroccan salon sofa drinking mint tea, DAD looking stern. GIRL's face visible in the foreground. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GIRL whispers into her phone with a sneaky smile, sitting hidden on the floor beside her bed with her knees up, one hand cupped around the phone. Night, soft lamp light. No text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: KOREAN standing on a Moroccan train platform at Casa Voyageurs station, looking at his phone and smiling, an orange-and-grey Moroccan train arriving behind him. No readable signs, no text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: GIRL in front of her bedroom mirror holding up an outfit against herself, grinning with secret excitement and biting her lip. Moroccan bedroom, morning light. No text.
